prompt.label: Medium/Hard — Knowledge Management Across Business Units
prompt.userMessage: As the organization has expanded globally, valuable operational knowledge has become fragmented across regional teams, SharePoint repositories, internal wikis, and archived project documents. Employees frequently recreate work because they cannot easily identify whether similar initiatives, lessons learned, or client deliverables already exist elsewhere in the company. Leadership believes there is significant untapped institutional knowledge, but accessing it today requires knowing exactly where to look or who to ask. We need a more effective way to connect employees with relevant business knowledge across the enterprise.

rounds.content:
{
  "action": "clarify",
  "round": 1,
  "message": "Lots of directions this could go — which is closest to what you want?

A) Knowledge Q&A assistant — employees ask questions in plain English, AI answers with citations from your SharePoint and wikis
B) Smart enterprise search — a search bar across all your sources with filters, ranking, and previews (no AI chat)
C) Project/initiative registry — a browsable catalog of past projects, deliverables, and lessons learned that people submit and tag
D) Expert finder — directory that maps topics to the people who worked on them, so employees know who to ask"
}

parsed.message: Building an AI-powered institutional knowledge Q&A assistant. Employees ask questions in plain English and get AI-generated answers with citations linking back to source passages from SharePoint, internal wikis, and archived project documents. Admins manage document sources, monitor a dashboard of top questions and coverage gaps (questions without good source answers), review audit logs of who asked what, and export question history to CSV. Leadership receives a periodic email digest summarizing popular topics and unanswered questions. Surfaces lessons learned and prior client deliverables to prevent duplicate work.

tasks.summary: Stores users, document sources, ingested documents, questions asked, AI-generated answers, citations, and audit logs.
tasks.task: Tables: users, sources, documents, questions, answers, citations, audit_logs. Indexes: FK columns, questions.created_at DESC, audit_logs.created_at DESC, answers.confidence (for coverage-gap queries). Column-level contract: data_model.

tasks.summary: Stores embedded chunks of ingested documents for semantic retrieval during Q&A.
tasks.task: pgvector extension. Table: doc_chunks(id SERIAL PK, document_id INTEGER NOT NULL, chunk_index INTEGER, content TEXT, embedding vector(3072), metadata JSONB, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()). Index: HNSW on embedding (vector_cosine_ops). Embedding model: text-embedding-3-large via MGA /embeddings.

tasks.summary: Handles Q&A requests with RAG retrieval+citations, document source registration and ingestion, admin dashboard data, audit logs, CSV export, and the leadership email digest job.
tasks.task: Data: pg Pool from env (DATABASE_* and VECTORDB_* hosts). Endpoints + bodies: api_contract. Behaviors + rules + side-effects: business_logic_contract. RAG flow: embed question via MGA text-embedding-3-large, top-K cosine search on doc_chunks, call MGA claude-opus-4.7 assistant with retrieved passages, return answer + citations[]; flag low-confidence as coverage gap. Ingestion: SharePoint connector + manual upload for wikis/archived project docs; chunk → embed → upsert. Weekly digest cron summarizes top questions + unanswered (low-confidence) topics, emails leadership. Auth: x-amzn-oidc-data JWT sub/email; first login creates users row; role defaults 'employee', admins set manually.

tasks.summary: Chat-style Q&A interface for employees with clickable citations, plus an admin dashboard for sources, coverage gaps, audit logs, and CSV export.
tasks.task: Views + components: ui_contract. Endpoints + body shapes: api_contract (prepend /api/). Citation chips open a source passage modal. Admin dashboard surfaces coverage gaps as first-class view. States: spinner, empty CTA, toast on 4xx/5xx, 404 page, disabled submit during POST, streaming/loading indicator while answer generates. Responsive. Preserve terminology: 'institutional knowledge', 'lessons learned', 'initiatives', 'client deliverables'.

tasks.summary: Wires database, vectordb, backend, and frontend together for local development.
tasks.task: Wire database, vectordb, backend, frontend. Backend env: DATABASE_HOST=database, DATABASE_PORT=5432, DATABASE_NAME=knowledge_qa, DATABASE_USER=knowledge_qa_user, DATABASE_PASSWORD=localdev123, VECTORDB_HOST=vectordb, VECTORDB_PORT=5433, VECTORDB_NAME=knowledge_qa_vec, VECTORDB_USER=knowledge_qa_vec_user, VECTORDB_PASSWORD=localdev123, MGA_API_KEY, SHAREPOINT_*, SMTP_* for digest. nginx.local.conf proxy /api→backend:3000. depends_on chain: database+vectordb → backend → frontend. Healthchecks on every service. Named volumes per DB.

pull documents from SharePoint connector or accept uploaded wiki/archive docs, chunk text, embed via MGA text-embedding-3-large, upsert into doc_chunks, update sources.last_ingested_at

rules: employees can only see their own questions and answers
only admins can create sources, trigger ingestion, upload documents, view dashboard/audit logs, or export CSV
every question must record user_id for audit traceability
answers with confidence below threshold or zero citations are marked is_coverage_gap=true and surfaced in admin dashboard
side_effects: audit log on every write (question asked, source created, ingest triggered, document uploaded, CSV exported)
audit log on citation generation capturing which documents were cited per answer

mga_assistants.name: Institutional Knowledge Assistant
mga_assistants.description: Answers employee questions about institutional knowledge, lessons learned, initiatives, and client deliverables using indexed SharePoint, wiki, and archived project documents. Always cites source passages.
starter_messages: What lessons learned do we have from past initiatives in this domain?
Has a client deliverable like this been produced before?
Summarize what we know about our onboarding process.
mga_assistants.instructions: Answer using only the retrieved passages. Always include citations. If retrieved context is insufficient, say so clearly so the question can be flagged as a coverage gap.
